author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಎಲ್ಲೆಲ್ಲಿ ಯಾರ್ಯಾರ ಗುರುವೆಂದು ಎಣಿಸುವೆಯೊ
ಅಲ್ಲೆಲ್ಲ ಕಾಣುವೆಯೊ ನಿಸ್ವಾರ್ಥ ನಡೆಯ
ಕಲ್ಲ ವಿಗ್ರಹಮಾಡಿ ಅನುಭವದ ಮೂಸೆಯಲಿ
ಸಲ್ಲಿಸುವ ಜಗಕೆನಿನ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Wherever you count someone as your guru,
there you will see selfless conduct;
carving you into an idol in the crucible of experience,
they offer you to the world, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: True teachers are recognised by their selflessness. Like a sculptor shaping stone, they form us through experience and present us to the world.
